Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_14625",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson","line":2654,"var":"idTypeDecoded","code":"UA_NodeId typeNodeId = UA_NODEID_NUMERIC(0, (UA_UInt32)idTypeDecoded)","role":"source","note":"The JSON input specifies Type:15 (ByteString), controlling the variant type and triggering ByteString decode path"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"ByteString_decodeJson","line":2209,"var":"tokenData","code":"unsigned char* unB64 = UA_unbase64(tokenData, (int)tokenSize, &flen)","role":"intermediate","note":"Calls UA_unbase64 with non-multiple-of-4 length base64 string from input"},
   {"step":3,"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_unbase64","line":113,"var":"flen","code":"*flen = 3*len/4 - pad","role":"root_cause","note":"Calculates output length via integer division but the loop below writes zero bytes when len<4 and pad==0, leaving allocated buffer uninitialized"},
   {"step":4,"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_unbase64","line":114,"var":"bin","code":"bin = (unsigned char*)malloc((size_t)(*flen))","role":"intermediate","note":"Allocates flen bytes (1 byte for len=2) but subsequent loop writes 0 bytes since charNo<=len-4-pad is false"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"ByteString_encodeJson","line":660,"var":"src->data","code":"char *ba64 = UA_base64(src->data, (int)src->length, &flen)","role":"intermediate","note":"During re-encoding, passes uninitialized ByteString data to UA_base64"},
   {"step":6,"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_base64","line":87,"var":"bin[byteNo]","code":"unsigned char BYTE0=bin[byteNo]","role":"sink","note":"Reads uninitialized memory from the ByteString buffer, triggering MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson","line":2654,"operands":["idTypeDecoded"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_unbase64","line":113,"operands":["len","4"],
     "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"len","right":"4"}},
   "sink":{"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_base64","line":87,"operands":["bin[byteNo]","BYTE0"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"byteNo","right":"len"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"ByteString_decodeJson","line":2209,"operands":["tokenData"]},
      "to":{"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_unbase64","line":113,"operands":["len"]},
      "type":"data","via":["tokenSize"]},
     {"from":{"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_unbase64","line":114,"operands":["bin"]},
      "to":{"file":"deps/base64.c","function":"UA_base64","line":87,"operands":["bin[byteNo]"]},
      "type":"data","via":["dst->data","src->data"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
